searchText: So in case of non legacy tx you guys prepend it with one byte of tx type, right? Nethermind, Besu and Reth currently return the RLP encoding of the receipt for typed txs, this encoding is an RLP byte array containing `tx-type || data` For legacy txs, it's just the normal encoding What we want returned there, for typed txs, is just the `tx-type || data` as hex without the outer RLP wrapper See what I mean here: https://hivetests2.ethdevops.io/suite.html?suiteid=1707979336-54d1b943ab3e0cf966e681ab2e2a959e.json&suitename=rpc-compat#test-8 Yeah, test shows we wrap it additionally, but there is no need looks like
